---
title: Coupling to water allocation model
---

It is possible to couple an external water allocation model:

```toml
[model]
external_water_allocation__flag = true
```

For this coupling to work it is required to implement a custom timestep coupling of Wflow
update functions (at `model` level) and the update of the water allocation model. This
implementation can for example be based on the `run_timestep!` function while replacing
sub-function `update_func(model)`. First the water demand needs to be computed by running
the following sub-functions of `update_model!`:

```julia
    update_interception_model!(model)
    update_snow_model!(model)
    update_glacier_model!(model)
    update_open_water_runoff_model!(model)
    update_water_demand_model!(model)
```

Then the update of the external water allocation model is possible based on the computed
water demand by Wflow and water allocated can be set in Wflow (e.g.
`land__allocated_irrigation_water_volume_flux`).

Finally, the remaining sub-functions of `update_model!` can be called:

```julia
    update_water_allocation_model!(model)
    update_soil_water_model!(model)
    update_land_surface_temperature!(model)
    update_subsurface_flow_model!(model)
    update_soil_water_storage!(model)
    surface_routing!(model)
    update_total_water_storage!(model)
```
